title: JSW Cement commissions additional 1Mt/yr cement grinding capacity at Nagaur plant
summary: JSW Cement commissions additional 1Mt/yr cement grinding capacity at Nagaur plant
body_markdown: **India:** JSW Cement has commissioned an additional 1Mt/yr of cement grinding capacity at its Nagaur plant in Rajasthan, taking the facility’s total grinding capacity to 3.5Mt/yr. JSW’s total grinding capacity is now 25.1Mt/yr. JSW Cement reportedly plans to build a larger presence in north India, where cement demand has been supported by new infrastructure and government capital expenditure.
